pools.descZh: 面向纯生存玩法: 基础物资, 战斗补给, 食物, 家畜与增益, 不含雷电与传送等趣味指令.
pools.descEn: Pure survival: supplies, combat gear, food, livestock and buffs, without lightning or teleport tricks.
